scene: Sparkling blue tea gives you a sudden rush of soaring energy.
picture: Flat side view of a bustling rooftop transit platform. On the far left, a giant paper-lantern balloon is tied to a railing. The player in her red bomber jacket stands left of centre holding an empty cup. Right of centre, a steaming noodle-cart monorail waits. Far right, a bamboo cable car hangs ready.
shown: A giant glowing paper-lantern balloon basket moored at the platform on the far left.
A yellow monorail cart shaped like a noodle bowl parked right of centre.
A woven green bamboo cable car dangling from an iron tower on the far right.
